title: IVI Internship Program
description: An internship at the International Vaccine Institute (IVI), an international organization dedicated to vaccine research, development, and delivery for low- and middle-income countries, working on hands-on global health projects. Onsite placement at IVI headquarters in Seoul, Republic of Korea is preferred, though remote work may be available depending on the specific project. Open to current undergraduate, postgraduate, or doctoral students, or those within one year of graduation, of any nationality. Interns receive an allowance (not a salary) of USD 200/week for full-time interns or USD 100/week for part-time interns (roughly USD 866/month equivalent for full-time), but no financial or administrative support is provided for travel, accommodation, or visa applications. Applications are accepted on a rolling basis with no fixed annual deadline found on the program's official page.
visaNote: This is an internship, not employment; interns are responsible for their own visa arrangements, travel, and accommodation costs in South Korea, or may be placed remotely depending on the project.
